Supratim Bhui

supratim.bhui1@gmail.com | +91 7209958998 |

linkedin.com/in/supratim-bhui-40b24618

Professional Summary Backend Software Engineer with 5 years of experience developing scalable software solutions and cloud-native microservices using Golang. Strong expertise in Go concurrency, goroutines, channels, REST APIs, gRPC, clean code, error handling and performance optimization. Experienced in building containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes and integrating Kafka, MongoDB, Redis and AWS services. Strong experience in Agile development, code reviews, production troubleshooting, cross-functional collab- oration and mentoring junior developers

Technical Skills Languages: Golang, SQL, Python, Java Go Programming: Goroutines, Channels, Context, Interfaces, Error Handling, Worker Pools, Mutexes, Synchronization, Profiling, Memory Management, Performance Optimization Backend Development: REST APIs, gRPC, Microservices, API Design, OpenAPI, Distributed Systems Databases: MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Redis, Schema Design, Indexing, Query Optimization, Connection Pooling Messaging: Apache Kafka, Event-Driven Architecture, Asynchronous Processing Cloud & Containers: AWS, S3, EC2, Lambda, API Gateway, Docker, Kubernetes, Cloud-Native Development Development Practices: Git, GitLab CI/CD, Agile/Scrum, Code Reviews, Unit Testing, Integration Testing, Debugging, Refac- toring, Technical Documentation Observability: Splunk, Prometheus, Grafana, Structured Logging, Metrics, Production Troubleshooting

Work Experience Pitney Bowes Senior Software Engineer

June 2024 – Present Go, AWS, Kafka, Kubernetes, Docker, Elasticsearch

Designed and developed scalable Go-based microservices and REST APIs supporting high-volume shipping and logistics workflows. • Implemented concurrent processing using goroutines, channels, worker pools and synchronization primitives to improve application throughput and responsiveness.

Applied clean Go design principles including small interfaces, context propagation, explicit error handling and reusable service components for maintainable production code.

Implemented Kafka-based asynchronous workflows and integrated cloud-native services using Docker, Kubernetes and AWS. • Collaborated with cross-functional teams, participated in design and code reviews, resolved production issues, and mentored junior developers on Go and microservice development.

Persistent Systems Software Engineer

Sept 2021 – May 2024 Golang, Kubernetes, Docker, MongoDB, Neo4j, GitLab CI/CD

Developed and maintained Go-based backend microservices and REST/gRPC APIs for scalable service-to-service communication. • Implemented concurrent and asynchronous processing using goroutines, channels and worker pools to support high-throughput workloads.

Containerized Go applications using Docker and deployed services on Kubernetes with focus on scalability, reliability and pro- duction support.

Collaborated with development and QA teams through Agile practices, code reviews, debugging and CI/CD workflows using Git and GitLab.

Selected Projects Go, MongoDB, Redis, Kafka, Kubernetes High-Scale Create Shipment API • Designed and developed a scalable Go-based shipment API using REST, supporting customer, address, parcel, and carrier

workflows.

Optimized MongoDB queries, indexing, Redis caching, and Go concurrency to improve API throughput and reduce database latency.

Implemented Kafka-based asynchronous processing with idempotency, retries, timeouts, and failure recovery for reliable dis- tributed workflows.

Bulk Shipment Processing Platform Go, Kafka, Worker Pools, MongoDB, Redis, Kubernetes • Built a high-throughput Go service to process thousands of shipment records using goroutines, channels, worker pools, and

controlled concurrency.

Implemented MongoDB bulk operations and Redis-based state management to reduce database overhead and improve processing efficiency.

Integrated Kafka consumer groups, retries, backpressure, and graceful shutdown for reliable asynchronous batch processing. Go, AWS S3, REST APIs, Kubernetes Electronic Trade Document API • Developed a Go REST API for secure upload and management of shipment-related commercial and customs documents using AWS S3 pre-signed URLs.

Implemented request/file validation, authentication, structured error handling, and secure document access patterns. • Containerized and deployed the service on Kubernetes with health checks, resource management, and production monitoring.

Education Academy of Technology B.Tech in Information Technology

2017 – 2021 CGPA: 8.52 / 10

Certifications Azure AZ-900 Certified

| HackerRank: Python Basics

| HackerRank: Golang Basics
